maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.detail: Thick webs covered the stone chamber. Pale green egg sacs clustered on the damp ground.
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.detail-3: Are you trying to help us?
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.detail-4: Step on the sensor at (13, -19) for the first time, and start the event "Encounter the Spider Obula".
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue: Choose “Try talking to the spider.” (Depends on story progress)
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue-1: As long as the brood remains untouched, she makes no move against you.
You speak, but the spider gives no sign of understanding.
She answers only with a low hiss.
Most of her eyes drift back to the eggs. The others remain fixed on you.
A clean wound beneath her abdomen catches your eye. No beast did this.
Someone deliberately removed her venomous stinger. Cleanly. Almost surgically.
You feel no fear for herself... only for the lives waiting inside the eggs.
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue-2: Thick webs blanket the chamber. Pale green egg sacs cluster across the damp floor.
Then comes unbearable pain. Something vital was torn from her body, leaving only an empty wound.
The spider shifts. Her legs tighten around the nearest eggs.
The sounds are little more than clicks and hisses, yet somehow they carry meaning.
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue-3: Are you trying to help us? (Depending on the progression of the story, only once)
"For flesh... No for little dying meat...."
Choose “Are you trying to help us?”
"Do not... touch the Old One's venom..."
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue-4: Most of her countless eyes watch the eggs. The others never leave you.
The spider lets out another painful hiss. "Speaking" has clearly exhausted her.
It seems she has said all she can. You are unlikely to learn anything more from her.
The spider watches you leave. Her mandibles click in the dark.
The spider raises her massive body. Her mandibles click with terrifying force.
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue-5: Try talking to the spider. (once only)
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue-7: Reach out through the spirit. (Party member required: Elk, Available once)
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue-8: Examine the spider closely. (Party member required: Ranger, Available once)
maps.points.swamp_spider_nest.dialogue-9: The spider stays close to her eggs, watching both them and you.
